steps.name: shield 1 ETH, 0.5 ETH, 500 tUSD (plus the protocol fee); wallet finds all three notes
alice sends 1.2 ETH privately to bob, relayed, asset hidden
bob finds 1.2 ETH; alice finds 0.3 ETH change; spent notes drop out
bob unshields 1 ETH to a fresh address (0.995 after the fee); relayer paid 0.001 ETH
replaying the same proof is refused: NullifierAlreadySpent
changing the recipient or the amount after proving is refused: InvalidProof
honest version of the same token unshield goes through
pool books match its balances; protocol fees accrue apart from them
anyone sweeps the fees to the fixed fee recipient
